text: Why can split horizon not completely solve count-to-infinity?
choices: It is not implemented correctly in most routers
It prevents a route being advertised back to the neighbour it came from, but loops involving three or more routers are unaffected
explanation: Split horizon, poison reverse and holddown each address part of the problem and none solves it, because a complete solution is not available within the distance-vector framework. RIP's answer is to define 16 hops as infinity and give up.
